requirement_text.ISS-0329: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs:140 sets realm = "jit-disabled-test-realm", a hardcoded literal, and inserts a tenant with it via insert_tenant_for_realm!/1. tenants.idp_realm_id carries a unique partial index (tenants_idp_realm_id_partial_index), so if any concurrently-running partition (or a leftover row from an earlier aborted run) already holds that realm id, the insert fails with Ecto.InvalidChangesetError: idp_realm_id has already been taken. Observed 2026-08-23 on a full sh scripts/test_parallel.sh with TEST_PARALLEL_N=4: partition 4 exited 2 with this single failure (combined 1985/1986). The same file passes in isolation (mix test <file> -> 3 passed), which is the signature of a cross-partition isolation defect rather than a logic bug. The fix is already present in the same file: the other two tests use the unique_realm/1 helper (lines 154 and 167). Line 140 is the lone holdout and should use it too. Same class as WF03-ISS0059-20260819 (commit 8870068), which fixed slugs but left this realm id behind. NOTE: scripts/test_parallel.sh reported this correctly in its per-partition summary AND in its combined line (1 failures), but still exited 0 while partition 4 exited 2.
